new_constructors.meaning: A source-local primitive disposal action retaining its parsed scope, action identity, action kind, composition mode, material class, action-specific trigger, timing, exception class, up to two exact exception clauses, and exact action clause. It is not a complete policy norm.
new_constructors.name: acq_disposal_action_v3

new_constructors.meaning: A source-local connection between the independently acquired return and destruction action identities, with the exact connecting clause.
new_constructors.name: acq_disposal_link_v3

new_constructors.meaning: An explicit source-local retention permission or prohibition with its basis, material boundary, continuing condition, and exact clause.
new_constructors.name: acq_retention_v3

new_constructors.meaning: A primitive source-local disclosure reading retaining effect, actor, recipient role, owner, need-to-know, necessary extent, confidentiality safeguard, exception form, and exact clause without completing elliptical wording.
new_constructors.name: acq_disclosure_v3

new_constructors.meaning: Declared source-program residual metadata for an unresolved interpretation or unacquired family. It is not a legal absence judgment.
new_constructors.name: acq_residual_v3

new_constructors.meaning: The source-classified material governed by one action, bounded by the exact action or retention clause.
new_constructors.name: acquired_material_v3

new_constructors.meaning: The source-classified action-specific trigger and timing, bounded by the exact connecting clause.
new_constructors.name: acquired_trigger_v3

new_constructors.meaning: The exact source-local qualifier or exception scope for one disposal or prohibition, retaining up to two exact clauses and never asserting global absence.
new_constructors.name: acquired_exception_scope_v3

new_constructors.meaning: The separately retained exception scopes of two connected actions; return and destruction exceptions are not flattened.
new_constructors.name: acquired_joint_exception_scope_v3

new_constructors.meaning: The two enclosed actions are alternatives under the exact source connector; each keeps its own material and exception scope.
new_constructors.name: acquired_action_alternative_v3

new_constructors.meaning: Both enclosed actions are required under the exact source connector; each keeps its own material and exception scope.
new_constructors.name: acquired_action_conjunction_v3

new_constructors.meaning: The source-stated retention basis and continuing restriction, bounded by the exact retention clause.
new_constructors.name: acquired_retention_condition_v3

new_constructors.meaning: Independent source-local readings of need-to-know, necessary extent, and confidentiality safeguard, bounded by the exact permission clause.
new_constructors.name: acquired_disclosure_condition_v3

new_constructors.meaning: A participant expressly named by the source text without mapping it to a company or source identity.
new_constructors.name: acquired_actor_v3

new_constructors.meaning: A source-bounded recipient class whose wording cannot safely be equated with an existing controlled recipient category.
new_constructors.name: acquired_recipient_class_v3

new_constructors.meaning: Executable coverage or interpretation residual requiring the lawful fallback/unknown channel; it is not a legal fact or complete-source absence certificate.
new_constructors.name: source_residual_observation_v3

rationale: 本次更新不再增加无法影响当前 G 的宽泛神经读取；规划器直接返回空查询。来源程序保留全部 incoming statements，并新增来源局部、动作级原子：返还与销毁分别记录材料、触发、期限和例外；连接词只在两个动作具有共同触发时组合，否则保留为两个义务。这样 6fce 的返还请求、Project 结束后销毁、Agreement 结束/请求返还、备份档案例外及法务部门争议副本均保持独立；8fb 只取得“请求时返还全部材料”，其披露句保留为 elliptical residual，不补写许可；a5b0 取得 Visitor 对来源指定 outsiders 的禁止原子，同时无处置匹配只进入 residual，而不推导 False 或完整来源缺失。G 继续保留旧根，并以可区分的精确组合规则生成新 Norm；候选中还保留 linked 动作拆分和无条件披露等较弱替代，供 TRAIN 约束排除。决策层保留既有正、负能力，并仅在来源 residual 无法支持确定解释时交还既有 fallback。有限词法原型不能证明完整英文语义或跨来源泛化，U 的 phi/G 字典仍为空，也不承诺分数提升。
